Name: Dwarf Beautified Versions
Author: DILETTANTETRANSLATOR
Description:
Just put the PNG assets from this mod into your portrait folder, and drop the XNB files into your Characters folder to replace the original ones. Remember to back up the original files first, darling.

Though there’s only one 64x64 dwarf portrait in the original portraits folder and I took an extra step, the first one in t e 4-grid layout will still work perfectly.
This is my first attempt—please leave me a message if any issues arise. Thank you!
